modDesc.title: Transport Company
modDesc.description:
Own and operate a trucking company.
Buy the Company Headquarters from the shop and place it on your farm. The dispatch office opens in the PDA (in-game menu) with three sections: Dispatch, Fleet and Ledger.
- Dispatch: contract board generates freight jobs from the map. Bulk contracts (liters, load at a station, deliver to a destination) and pallet contracts (counted objects). Accept a job, grab a truck and deliver - or hand it to a hired driver, who hauls it with the base game AI. - Fleet: every registered truck keeps its own books - revenue, fuel cost, distance and profit per truck. - Ledger: company totals, jobs completed and overall profit/loss.
Money is paid into your farm balance with the base game finance system, all gameplay uses stock FS25 behaviors (hired AI, mission timers, hints, settings, savegame and multiplayer included).
Changelog: v1.0.0.0 - ModHub-ready release
